connectorUiConfig.title: Fortinet FortiNDR Cloud (Detections via CCF)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The Fortinet FortiNDR Cloud data connector provides the capability to ingest [Fortinet FortiNDR Cloud Detections](https://docs.fortinet.com/product/fortindr-cloud) data into Microsoft Sentinel using the FortiNDR Cloud REST API. This is a serverless implementation using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF).

**Note:** This connector ingests **Detections data only**. For Observation and Suricata event logs, continue using the Azure Function-based connector.

sampleQueries.query:
FncEventsDetections_CL
 | where Status == 'active'
 | summarize Count=count() by RuleSeverity
 | sort by Count desc

FncEventsDetections_CL
 | summarize Count=count() by RuleName
 | top 10 by Count desc

dataTypes.name: FncEventsDetections_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
FncEventsDetections_CL
 | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
 | where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: FortiNDR Cloud API Credentials
customs.description: **API Token** and **Account UUID** are required. These can be obtained from your FortiNDR Cloud account management portal.

customs.name: FortiNDR Cloud API Domain
customs.description: **API Domain** (default: icebrg.io) - only change if directed by Fortinet support.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Obtain FortiNDR Cloud API Credentials
instructionSteps.description:
Log in to your FortiNDR Cloud portal and navigate to the account management section to obtain:

- **API Token**: Your authentication token
- **Account UUID**: Your account identifier
- **API Domain** (optional): Typically 'icebrg.io' unless you're using a custom domain

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure Detection Filtering (Optional)
instructionSteps.description:
You can configure which detections to ingest:

- **Detection Status**: Choose 'active', 'resolved', or 'all' (default: all)
- **Pull Muted**: Choose whether to include muted detections, devices, and rules (default: all)

instructionSteps.title: 3. Connect to FortiNDR Cloud
instructionSteps.description: Enter your FortiNDR Cloud credentials below and click **Connect** to start ingesting detection data.
